lines: d28: 📖 The Codex turns a page on its own. Hermann Weinstein is dead. You didn't ask. It knew.
d28: Nobody's talking much. The fire feels smaller tonight.
d28: 🕯️ Hermann Weinstein is dead — the wild. The village stops. Somebody screams. Somebody else starts digging.
d28: What Hermann kept close goes into the ground with them — keepsakes are buried, never taken from the body.
d28: "Hermann's gone." Thabo looks at you for a long moment. "You're not Hermann." No heat in it. Just fact. You'll have to earn this face.
d28: The Codex doesn't pause for grief. Stan blinks — and it's already there, overlaying everything, syncing. No pen. No paper. The mantle just... transfers.
d28: 📖 LEARNED: Tainted Bait (Level 1). Your bait is tainted — traps catch 50% more. (The poison’s in the bait, not your hands. Mostly.)
d28: 📖 LEARNED: Reading Tracks (Level 1). Fresh tracks have sharp edges. Old tracks crumble. You can tell how recently something passed.
d28: 📖 LEARNED: Animal Behavior (Level 1). Most animals flee. Give them an escape route and they take it. Cornered animals fight.
d28: 📖 LEARNED: Wire Snares (Level 1). A loop of wire on a game trail. Simple, effective, ancient. Check at dawn.
d28: 📖 LEARNED: Tripwire (Level 1). You string a wire at ankle height. The next monster that moves eats dirt — prone, stunned, and embarrassed. (Sets up the party.)
d28: 📖 LEARNED: Field Dressing (Level 1). Break down game fast and clean. Less waste, more meat, usable parts.
d28: 📖 LEARNED: Soft Step (Level 1). Move through woods like weather. Less noise, fewer surprises.
d28: 🌟 "MANTLE TRANSFER DETECTED. ...Oh! New face! Same job! Whole new set of tricks. We hardly noticed. (That is a lie. We noticed. The audience CRIED.)"
d28: 📖 The Codex turns a page: Hermann Weinstein, 28 days. The mantle passes to Stan Kowalski.
d28: 🪞 You wake up somebody else. Stan Kowalski, 47 — an exterminator. His hands know different work now: Beast-calm, Lucky Rock, Trophy Room.
d28: ◈ The System updates its file: the new bearer <redacted> "Stalker of the Apex Predator." It had a word for this one before the Codex came.
d28: The village's quarrel was with Hermann — and Hermann is dead. The sentence doesn't cross the grave. You're someone else now; the docket is empty, but the village remembers.
d28: At the grave, Javier, Vincent, Muhindo and 6 more speak for Stan — "Hermann trusted them. We saw it. Give them the fire's hearing." The village listens.
d28: The fire knew Stan before the Codex did — his name already carried weight here.
